visual.name: orgChart
visual.description: Org chart that morphs into clusters by team or location: expand and collapse, find a person, zoom, click to filter.

en-US.Visual_NoDataHint: Add Item (one card per person) and Parent (their manager's Item); Label names the card, Group A and Group B make the cluster views.
en-US.Visual_TooManyHint: Showing {0} of {1} items. Filter the page to see the rest.
en-US.Visual_Headline_Selected: {0} of {1} selected. {2} holds {3}% of the selection.
